company.name: Company

dashboard.title: Home
dashboard.comingBody: People, calendar and planning arrive here as they're built. Start by inviting your team in Settings.

general.title: General
general.addressHint: Changing the address breaks old links to this workspace.

features.title: Features
features.intro: Switch on what this workspace uses. Turning a feature off hides it; its data is kept.
features.confirmBody: These features depend on it and will be turned off too: {features}.

people.name: People
people.description: Directory, profiles, hierarchy, positions, custom fields and import.

time.name: Calendar and time off
time.description: Calendar, time types, leave, allowances and approvals.

rate_cards.name: Rate cards
rate_cards.description: Cost rules applied to people and planned roles.

members.title: Members
members.rolesDialogBody: Each role adds permissions. Owners have every permission anyway.
members.deactivateBody: They lose access straight away. Their history stays, and you can reactivate them later.

members.makeOwnerBody: Owners have every permission, including managing other owners.
members.leaveBody: You'll lose access straight away. An admin can invite you back later.
members.noUnits: No units yet: this role gives no access until you choose some.
members.unitsBody: {name} gets this role's access in these units and everything under them.

invite.description: Invite people by email and manage pending invitations.

view.description: See the reporting chart and hierarchy.

book_for_others.name: Book for others

view_audit.description: See who changed access and settings, and when.

roles.title: Roles
roles.intro: A role is a set of permissions. Give people several roles; their permissions add up.
roles.adminNotice: The Admin role has every permission across the workspace and can't be changed.
roles.readOnly: You can see this role but not change it.
roles.nameTaken: A role with that name already exists.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Changes to access and settings. Entries can't be edited or deleted.

profile.title: Profile
profile.photoHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 2 MB.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.intro: You always see notifications in Strata. Choose which ones also come by email.
notifications.emailNotice: Emails start once Strata's email sending is set up.

role.removed: The {role} role was removed from you

ownership.received: You're now an owner of this workspace

hierarchy.title: Hierarchy
hierarchy.intro: How your organization is grouped. Levels name the layers, such as Division, Department and Team; units are the groups themselves. A unit may skip levels but never sits under a lower one.

levels.title: Levels
levels.intro: From the top down. Rename or reorder them at any time.
levels.empty: No levels yet. Add one, such as Department, to start building units.
levels.units: {count, plural, =0 {No units} one {# unit} other {# units}}
levels.name: Name

units.title: Units
units.name: Name
units.codeHelp: Optional. Matches the unit in imports, such as a cost centre.
units.noLevels: No level fits here. Add a level below {parent}'s, or choose another place.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.intro: The building blocks of each person's job record. Archived entries stay on past records but can't be chosen for new ones.
jobs.name: Name

levels.title: Career levels
levels.intro: One ladder, junior first. Tracks, such as Individual contributor and Management, are optional.
levels.trackHelp: Optional. Levels on the same track are ranked against each other.

positions.title: Positions
positions.intro: Job titles, each with the career levels it spans.

types.title: Employment types
types.intro: How people work for you, and how their cost is worked out.
types.day_rateHelp: Costed as day rate × working days.

fields.title: Custom fields
fields.intro: Details your organization keeps about people, such as Location, Grade or Capex or Opex. They work like built-in fields in tables, filters, imports and rate cards.
fields.label: Label
fields.keyHelp: Used by imports and rate cards. It can't change later.
fields.sensitiveHelp: Only people who can see pay for a person see this field. Everyone sees their own.
fields.keepHistoryHelp: Changes are dated, like job records, so past values stay.

people.title: People
people.emptyHint: Try other words or clear the filters.

details.title: Details
details.personKeyHelp: Your HR system's id for this person; imports match on it.

jobRecord.title: Job
jobRecord.effectiveHelp: Today, a past date to correct history, or a future date to schedule the change.
jobRecord.removeBody: The record before it carries on in its place.

leaving.title: End date
leaving.body: The day they leave. They stay in history and reports, and drop out of current lists after that day.

views.name: Name
